sql.query: UPDATE tbl_contract_clauses c SET c.clauseName=:clauseName,c.clauseCategory=NULLIF(:category,''),c.clauseHtml=:clauseHtml,c.sortOrder=:sortOrder,c.isActive=:isActive,c.modifiedByUserId=:userId,c.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE c.id=:id AND c.tenantId=:tenantId AND NULLIF(TRIM(:nameCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:htmlCheck),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=c.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
